component.name: Liquid Calendar
component.summary: Plan events and tasks in a local glass calendar

description.p: A local desktop calendar with month, week and agenda views, undated tasks, projects, checklists, reminders and event templates.
Link related events while retaining independent details and display contained events inside their longer time frame. Export JSON backups and ICS events without an account.
Reworked linked events, nested display and calendar interaction fixes.
